_doc: Curated projected starting XIs (editorial). Used ONLY when API-Football has no confirmed line-up and no previous real line-up. Any API line-up overrides this automatically. Keyed by team name (normalized internally). player fields: name (required), number, pos (GK|DF|MF|FW), id (API-Football player id -> /portraits/{id}.png), img (file in public/portraits-local -> /portraits-local/{img}), grid (row:col). Head-shots are auto-attached by matching these names to the team's real API squad, so ids are optional. Order xi GK -> DF -> MF -> FW to match the formation. updated = YYYY-MM-DD.
